shortDescription: India's UltraTech Cement NSE:ULTRACEMCO on Thursday launched its wires and cables business, Ultravolt, with a planned investment of 18 billion rupees ($190.5 million), marking the Aditya Birla Group's fourth new business foray in three years.($1 = 94.4850 Indian rupees)
